jobs.description: This is a new, dedicated Commercial Sales Manager (m/f/d) position created to provide specialized oversight for the Erfurt factory's generator business. including the Project Approval and Tender Approval Committee (PATAC) workflow, bond applications, and financial clearances.- Ensure the fulfillment of contractual financial obligations, coordinating with finance on topics such as invoicing and payment terms.- Continuously improve commercial sales processes to enhance efficiency and mitigate risks.- Serve as the primary commercial liaison for key external clients, managing complex requirements related to international tax issues, permanent establishment (PE) setup, and local installation services.- Collaborate closely with the technical sales team to ensure proposed solutions are commercially viable and to prevent execution problems on complex projects.- Identify, assess, and mitigate commercial, financial, and contractual risks throughout the entire sales cycle.- Coach and delegate work to lower-level professionals, acting as a subject matter expert for commercial sales processes.What You Bring- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.- Several years of experience in a senior commercial sales, contract management, or bid management role, preferably within the power generation or heavy industrial equipment sector.- Demonstrated experience managing large, complex international projects and navigating associated tax, legal, and logistical challenges.- Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and financial calculation tools is required.- German and English fluency.Rewards/Benefits- In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the jobs.occupation: Doctoral researcher (m/f/d/x) in microbial systems biophysics (Biophysiker/in)
jobs.description: Founded in 1409, Leipzig University is one of Germany’s largest universities and a leader in research and medical training. With around 30,000 students and more than 5000 members of staff across 14 faculties, it is at the heart of the vibrant and outward-looking city of Leipzig. Leipzig University offers an innovative and international working environment as well as an exciting range of career opportunities in research, teaching, knowledge and technology transfer, infrastructure and administration.The Division of Systems Biophysics of Microbial Dynamics at the Peter Debye Institute for Soft Matter Physics at the Faculty of Physics and Earth System Sciences, seeks to fill the above position.About the position- Salary group 13 TV-L - Fixed-term position in accordance with the training plan, initially for 1 year; an extension of the fixed-term contract is planned- 50 % of a full-time position- As soon as possibleThe newly formed Division of Systems Biophysics of Microbial Dynamics (https://home.uni-leipzig.de/sysbiophys/) , led by Professor Katja Taute, is part of the Peter Debye Institute for Soft Matter Physics (https://www.physes.uni-leipzig.de/en/pdi) , which hosts a broad range of biophysics research. Active matter, including bacterial systems, is a growing key research area at the Institute. Our research group develops and uses biophysical methods, including high-throughput, 3D bacterial tracking and microfluidics, in combination with theory and simulations, to quantitatively analyse the spatio-temporal dynamics of bacteria at the level of individuals and populations. One research focus is the chemotactic navigation of bacteria in mechanically complex environments. In nature, swimming bacteria navigate relative to chemical stimuli in environments ranging from open waters to soil and the gut.The new doctoral researcher is to investigate how the gut bacterium E. coli navigates mechanically complex environments that mimic properties of its natural habitat. Properties of both the bacteria and the environment will be modulated in a controlled fashion to identify the underlying physical mechanisms and address the following questions:- What is the relationship between behavioural and material parameters that enable optimal navigation?- Is optimal intracellular information processing specific to the type of environment?- How do bacteria navigate mechanical gradients?The role- Independent, original, experimental scientific research on the above project- Additional scientific qualification (preparing a doctoral thesis)- Thorough documentation of research- Publication of research results, for example at conferences, workshops, or in scientific articles- Contributions to the Institute’s teaching responsibilitiesAbout you- An excellent scientific university degree (master of science or comparable) in (bio-)physics, (bio-)engineering or a related field- Very good command of at least one programming language (Matlab or Python jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer Awareness und Prevention (m/w/d) - Essen (GER) or Madrid (SP) (Compliance-Manager/in)
jobs.description: CompanyThrough its Rothe Erde, Uhde and Polysius businesses as well as the majority investment thyssenkrupp nucera, Decarbon Technologies delivers innovative, cutting-edge technologies for the transition to a climate-neutral industrial economy. Rothe Erde is a leading provider of bearings and solutions that play a key role in wind, solar and tidal power plants, among other things. With its solutions for decarbonization, defossilization and the circular economy, Uhde is a technology and implementation provider of large-scale plants for the chemical industry. Polysius supplies green technologies for the cement and lime industry, digital automation solutions, and on-site and remote maintenance services. thyssenkrupp nucera is a global supplier of electrolysis technology for the industrial-scale production of clean hydrogen. The segment employs around 12,000 people, who generated revenues of approximately 3.8 billion euros in fiscal year 2023/2024.Your responsibilities- You will actively contribute to the further development and effective implementation of the Compliance Management System within the Decarbon Technologies segment and take ownership of selected compliance areas, including anti-corruption, data compliance, anti-money laundering, and export control/trade compliance. A key focus of your role will be the provision of antitrust and competition law advice as well as the further development and implementation of competition law compliance measures.- You will help ensure that segment-wide standards are adhered to, compliance risks are identified at an early stage, and regulatory requirements are implemented efficiently across the organization.- As part of a holistic compliance approach, you will advise and support the business on additional compliance topics, particularly with regard to the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act (LkSG) and related regulatory requirements.- You will advise the companies within the thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies segment on a broad range of compliance matters. This includes, among other things, providing antitrust and competition law advice in MundA projects, addressing liability-related questions arising from the application of the Compliance Program, and supporting the coordination and enablement of Compliance Officers in the Business Units and regions. In doing so, you will contribute to the effective and consistent implementation of compliance requirements throughout the segment.- You will support compliance reporting at segment and Group level, assist in the development of compliance processes, policies, concepts, and preventive measures, and accompany their implementation in an international environment.- You will monitor and analyze regulatory developments and compliance risks, derive appropriate measures, and support their implementation.- In addition, you will independently manage cross-functional compliance projects and actively drive the further development of the compliance organization and compliance culture within the segment.Your profile- You are passionate about working collaboratively and excited to contribute to the further evolution of Compliance at thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies during a period of transformation and growth.- You hold an degree in Law and have successfully completed the Second German State Examination (Second State Exam) or possess an equivalent legal qualification. Additional qualifications, such as an LL.M. or other postgraduate degree, are considered an asset.- You bring significant and recent experience in a senior compliance role within an international corporation or complex business environment. You have a proven track record of not only advising on compliance matters, but also shaping, implementing, and continuously improving compliance programs and governance frameworks.- You have extensive expertise in the design, implementation, and enhancement of Compliance Management Systems (CMS).- You have substantial experience advising on competition and antitrust law matters in an international business context, including cooperation agreements, distribution structures, public tenders, and MundA transactions.- Your expertise covers key compliance areas, including competition law, anti-corruption, data protection and digital regulation, anti-money laundering, and trade compliance.- You combine strong legal and regulatory knowledge with a pragmatic, business-oriented approach and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical solutions.- You are an effective communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust and credibility across all levels of the organization.- You thrive in an international and cross-cultural environment and distinguish yourself through integrity, discretion, resilience, and a high level of personal accountability.- You have successfully led complex, cross-functional, and international projects and are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.- You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. German and Spanisch language skills are highly desirable.Your benefitsAt thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies, we are committed to providing an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. Our benefits include:- The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by contributing to the continued growth and success of thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies in a dynamic and future-oriented industry.- A competitive compensation package combined with attractive benefits.- Flexible working hours, hybrid and mobile working arrangements, and the opportunity, subject to agreement, to work remotely from within the European Union for up to 20 days per year.- A wide range of health and wellbeing initiatives, including confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services, preventive healthcare offerings through our occupational health service (such as health screenings and seasonal vaccinations), and various sports and wellness programs.- Extensive professional and personal development opportunities through a broad portfolio of training programs, learning initiatives, and career opportunities across the thyssenkrupp Group.- A structured and personalized onboarding program designed to help you settle in quickly and build a strong network from day one.Contactthyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies GmbHSofie PutschkeHuman ResourcesWe value diversityWe value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, or gender identity.
